# 太上洞淵三昧神咒齋清旦行道儀--杜光庭

**ID:** KR5b0229
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0229

## Authors / Editors
- 杜光庭? 編 850 - 933

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Second of Dù Guāngtíng's three *Dòngyuān shénzhòu* liturgies (cf. [KR5b0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0228), [KR5b0230](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0230)). The opening rubric specifies "*the dawn-cultivation rite of the Tàishàng Dòngyuān Sānmèi Shénzhòu Fast (the noon and evening rites in the original are missing*)" — i.e. only the dawn rite survives; the noon and evening rites of the cycle have been lost. The fascicle is paired with [KR5b0230](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0230) under the rubric *二儀同卷化八* ("two liturgies in one fascicle, *Huà* 8"). The internal attribution again gives 廣成先生杜光庭刪定 (Guǎngchéngxiānshēng Dù Guāngtíng, collated and fixed).

**Abstract**

The work gives the dawn audience proper to the *Sānmèi shénzhòu zhāi*. The celebrants stand in formation before the *xuánshī* 玄師 ("Mysterious Master" — i.e. the master-presiding altar) and chant the *chàngdào* 唱道 declaration; the *Huáxià zàn* hymn is sung in procession; the *rùhùzhòu* 入戸呪 is recited; the five-directional incense is offered, beginning with the *dōngfāng* 東方 (east). The dawn position of the rite within the day's three audiences is consistent with the older Língbǎo *zhāi* schema preserved in Lù Xiūjìng (cf. [KR5b0227](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0227)), confirming that Dù's "*shānd dìng*" preserved the structural backbone of the older transmission.

Per Schipper & Verellen (*Taoist Canon* 2: 1024, John Lagerwey, DZ 526), the loss of the noon and evening rites is already noted in the *Zhèngtǒng dàozàng* recension.
